intent.responsibility: Own the complete current Component configuration and its exact Runtime Input contract.
intent.visualBoundary: Resolve the Component through its manifest-declared resolver and renderable boundary.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Consume only declared Runtime Inputs and explicit embedded Component boundaries.
intent.forwarding: Forward values only through declared stable source and target identities.
intent.temporalOwnership: Keep reusable behavior relative to the Component owner and its declared child owners.
